PF1GESTALT.LevelUp.CatchUpASI: This level catches up the lower gestalt track and does not increase the character's total level, so it grants no additional ability score increase.
PF1GESTALT.LevelUp.CatchUpFCB: A favored-class bonus is granted once per character level. It was already available when the leading gestalt track gained this level.
